definitions.gloss: training; instruction (especially for skills like driving)
definitions.explanation: Formal instruction or training, most strongly associated in modern Japanese with driving schools ({自動車|じどうしゃ}{教習所|きょうしゅうじょ}). Combines {教|きょう} ("teach") with {習|しゅう} ("learn, practice"). Although it can in principle apply to any structured training, in everyday speech it almost always evokes driving instruction unless context specifies otherwise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教習|きょうしゅう}だ。
examples.english: Today is my first driving lesson.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦{教習所|きょうしゅうじょ}→教習所：12929_kyoushuujo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My older brother is attending driving school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{路上|ろじょう}→路上：19441_rojou⟧{教習|きょうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{教官|きょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}{事項|じこう}→注意事項：30548_chuuijikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Before the on-road lesson, the instructor explained the points to watch out for.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{教習|きょうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: I started lessons during a busy stretch at work, so it took half a year to graduate from driving school.

notes:
{教習|きょうしゅう} is a formal noun referring to structured instruction or training. In modern usage, the word is most strongly associated with driving instruction — to the point that {教習|きょうしゅう}, ⟦{教習所|きょうしゅうじょ}→教習所：12929_kyoushuujo⟧, and {教習生|きょうしゅうせい} are heard mainly in driving-school contexts.

FORMS:
- {教|きょう} ("teach") + {習|しゅう} ("learn, practice") → {教習|きょうしゅう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教習|きょうしゅう}{所|じょ}: training school, especially driving school
- ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦{教習所|きょうしゅうじょ}→教習所：12929_kyoushuujo⟧: driving school
- {教習|きょうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to take a lesson, to undergo training
- {教習|きょうしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧: to attend lessons (regularly)
- ⟦{路上|ろじょう}→路上：19441_rojou⟧{教習|きょうしゅう}: on-the-road driving lesson
- {仮免|かりめん}{教習|きょうしゅう}: instruction with a learner's permit
- {教習|きょうしゅう}{生|せい}: a student (at a driving school)
- {教習|きょうしゅう}{車|しゃ}: a driving-school car (marked with a green-and-yellow shoshinsha sign)

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: education (broad term covering schooling and upbringing)
- ⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧: training (often physical or skills-based; military, emergency drills, sports)
- ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: professional training (used by companies and government bodies)
- {講習|こうしゅう}: short course or seminar (often a one-off or short series)
- ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: guidance, instruction (focuses on the act of guiding rather than the program)

USAGE:
- Japan has a strong driving-school culture: most learners enroll in a ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦{教習所|きょうしゅうじょ}→教習所：12929_kyoushuujo⟧, complete classroom lectures and on-road lessons, and "graduate" before taking the licensing exam. Because of this, {教習|きょうしゅう} alone often means "driving instruction" in casual speech.
- For non-driving training, ⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧, ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧, or {講習|こうしゅう} are usually more natural. For instance, a company workshop is a ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧, not a {教習|きょうしゅう}.
- Note the homophone ⟦{郷愁|きょうしゅう}→郷愁：06000_kyoushuu⟧ ("nostalgia") — same reading, completely different kanji and meaning.
